ClinVar ID for the allele (the specific DNA change)
Kind of variant: single nucleotide variant, deletion, duplication, etc.
Short gene name(s), e.g. BRCA1; several separated by ;
Official gene ID from the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee
Overall germline label: Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic, Uncertain significance, Likely benign, Benign, Conflicting…
Simplified label: 1 = at least one pathogenic/likely pathogenic, 0 = none, -1 = no data
Date the variant was last evaluated (text, e.g. "Mar 05, 2019")
ID in the dbVar database (large structural variants)
ClinVar record IDs for each variant–condition pair
IDs of the linked conditions in other databases (MedGen, OMIM…)
Names of the linked conditions; several separated by |
Where the variant came from: germline, somatic, de novo, etc.
Genome build (DNA map): GRCh37, GRCh38, NCBI36
Reference sequence ID of the chromosome
How the label was reviewed (single submitter, multiple submitters, expert panel, practice guideline…)
How many labs/groups submitted this variant
Whether a genetic test for it is listed in the Genetic Testing Registry (Y/N)
Code for the kind of organizations that submitted
ClinVar variation ID (one per variant; used to remove duplicates)
Review status of the somatic classification
Whether the variant drives cancer (oncogenic / benign…)
Review status of the oncogenicity classification
Submission IDs behind the germline label
Submission IDs behind the somatic label
Submission IDs behind the oncogenicity label
